grading_method: After notification, verify each exact manifest/input/answer hash and full declared frozen source inventory before grading. Use only its exact anonymous final, original question/rubric/host contract and matching full source. No run/condition/pair/resource/trajectory inputs.

Read and judge each full answer independently; cite exact answer text and line/offset with verified source path/range, file hash and span hash. Do not infer omitted final-answer content from a source citation or trajectory.

Keep source registries keyed by immutable source inventory, path and range. Share verified immutable source references where identities match, but never substitute reviewer-added source for an answer-submitted citation or let another answer supply missing reasoning.

Award only the original integer anchors/point units. Record complete criterion_points using original IDs for every answer. Do not convert a mandatory/citation/contradiction failure to zero quality points.

Keep mandatory, submitted-citation and explicit material contradiction/disqualification audits separate. Accept equivalent source ranges and causal wording; no fixed phrase/file-count/curated-span demand. Omission is not an explicit opposite claim.

For a truly unresolved criterion, criterion_points is null and criterion_score_bounds reflects its still-possible original allowed scores. Resolved criterion bounds are [score,score]. score_lower/upper sum bounds; score_exact remains null unless every criterion is resolved. No half-points or imputation.

A missing/unavailable final remains null with original criterion bounds and an availability reason; do not manufacture a zero or completed observation. Distinguish this from an available, verified empty final, which has observable omission and a failed nonempty gate.

source_grounded_success is true only when all original requirements are established; false when an established required gate fails; null when material uncertainty could decide success and no known required failure already decides it. Keep the underlying uncertain fields even if another gate establishes failure.
Retain q001 C6 sensitivity independently of primary points. Retain unresolved disputes and original report bytes; any later correction is separately annotated.

Finish and seal task reports without accessing secondary reports or condition mapping. This primary review supplies anonymous per-answer quality scores only; condition/profile means, paired deltas, SD and equal-task macro statistics belong to the later authorized mapping/aggregation stage.
